title: Image Director structured edit plan
$comment: V1 schema. Emitted by the Analyzer (Layer A, Qwen2.5-VL 7B) and consumed by the router and generation/editing branches (Layer B). See docs/source/IMAGE_DIRECTOR_AUDIT.md §9 for the V1 architecture. Known gap: V1 does not enforce that edits[].reference_slots values must exist as keys under images (e.g. reference_slots:["image3"] when images.image3 is absent) - expressible with finite image2/image3 conditionals but not worth the complexity here, so the router must check it instead. Routing (task -> branch) is deliberately NOT part of this schema: the router resolves task=generate/edit to a branch deterministically and logs that decision separately, rather than trusting an analyzer-authored route field.

user_instruction.description: Verbatim (or lightly cleaned) user instruction, kept for logging and reproducibility, separate from the model-facing prompt.

prompt.description: Model-facing prompt text handed to the selected branch (Z-Image Turbo for generate, Qwen Image Edit 2511 for edit).

is_local_region.description: Required when task=edit. Satisfies the router acceptance criterion of correctly identifying local-region edits. Not a general edit-type taxonomy - just the one distinction V1 acts on.

images.description: Keys are the literal ComfyUI TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus input slot names (image1/image2/image3), not abstract ids - confirmed against tests/vram/combined-multiref/build_graph.py.

preserve.description: Flat list of subjects/regions/attributes the editing branch must not change.
